[Act: income-tax-1961
 Chapter: COMPUTATION OF TOTAL INCOME Heads of income
 Section: 29::Income from profits and gains of business or profession, how computed.
]


The income referred to in section 28 shall be computed in accordance with the provisions contained in sections 30 to 43D.
